description: Workload configurations for Synapse Botanicals Order Coordinator & Hold Middleware Benchmark

workloads.name: Baseline Sequential Flow
workloads.description: 50 sequential customer hold requests under standard staging network conditions.

workloads.name: High-Concurrency Flash-Sale Burst
workloads.description: 50 simultaneous hold requests arriving in parallel to evaluate lock contention and event-loop queueing.

workloads.name: Downstream 3PL Latency Degradation
workloads.description: Simulates 3PL WMS webhook slow responses under warehouse wave batch load.

workloads.name: Duplicate Webhook Re-Delivery
workloads.description: Evaluates idempotency key deduplication: second delivery returns cached 200 OK immediately with 0 downstream calls.

workloads.name: Warehouse Cutoff Race (PONR Breach)
workloads.description: Simulates request arriving after warehouse wave picking has commenced; verifies fast 409 Conflict rejection.

workloads.name: WMS Gateway Timeout & Rollback
workloads.description: Simulates HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout from 3PL; tests graceful failure and escalation queue tagging.
